h: לְרֹאשׁ חוֹדֶשׁ אֱלוּל, ה׳ Rosh Chodesh Elul, 5

p: and the Name Ehyeh filled with Yuds,
in which there are three Yuds, etc.;
which is the Name Ban, etc.;
and this is the secret of the verse (Yeshayahu 43:16):
'Who places a way in the sea.'"
Now, the four fillings of Havayah
correspond to the four letters of Havayah:
the Name Av (72) corresponds to the Yud,
וְשֵׁם ס"ג כְּנֶגֶד ה׳ עִלָּאָה בִּינָה,
the Name Sag to the upper Hei, Binah;
and the Name Ehyeh filled with Yuds,
this Name alludes to Kesser Elyon,
as is said in the holy Zohar
and it is the secret of Daas,
which is the inner dimension of Kesser Elyon,
and it is the grasp of Kesser Elyon.
And Daas is attained through Binah,
in the manner of what is said (Mishlei 2:10):
knowledge will be pleasant to your soul."
And this is what is said, "Who places a way in the sea":
"yam," the sea, is the attribute of Malchus,
in "the springs of the great deep" —
we call it Torah she'b'al peh"
which are Binah, as mentioned above,
which shines from the upper Hei
has the numerical value of Ban (52),
which is the Name Havayah doubled,
that "kefila" (doubled) alludes to the Name Ban.
וּבַזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (זֹהַר חֵלֶק א רז, א)
And in the holy Zohar (Zohar I 207a):
that Yaakov ascended in the World to Come.
And this is the general kavanah of the month.
For the month of Av was created with the letter Tes,
which points to the light "that it was good"
and it is the attribute of Tzaddik, Yesod Olam;
that was hidden away for the tzaddikim.
And it is a preparation for the month of Elul,
which was created with the letter Yud,
which is the attribute of Malchus,
that is, to bestow from the primordial light
upon the attribute of Malchus, the mouth,
And because of this the month of Av was created
for the whole purpose of the exiles
the spreading of Torah she'b'al peh.
And the month of Elul is the time
when the light "that it was good" becomes fixed
in the attribute of Malchus, the mouth,
that they suffer in this world
but are destined to rejoice in the end,
"to do good for you at your end";
meaning, to merit the light "that it was good."
"And it says, 'Light is sown for the tzaddik,'"
which refers to the primordial light
that shines for those who toil in Torah she'b'al peh,
וְאַחַר כָּךְ הֵבִיא פָּסוּק (מִשְׁלֵי ד, יח)
"And the path of the righteous is like the glow of light,"
and it is written, "growing ever brighter
כְּעֵין שֶׁכָּתוּב (זֹהַר חֵלֶק א מז, ב)
similar to what is written (Zohar I 47b):
"'The seventh day' is Torah she'b'al peh,
And this is a preparation for Tishrei,
that they be redeemed in Tishrei
is "Who places a way in the sea":
the two Names that are from Binah,
"After Hashem your God shall you walk";
is the Master of your powers,
and after Him you shall walk
"Fortunate are those whose way is perfect,
who walk in the Torah of Hashem."
"Tamim" indicates the perfection of the way,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁמָּצִינוּ בְּאַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
as we find with Avraham Avinu, a"h:
הִתְהַלֵּךְ לְפָנַי וֶהְיֵה תָמִים (בְּרֵאשִׁית יז, א).
"Who walk in the Torah of Hashem":
they walk as a matter of course in the Torah of Hashem.
"And your ears shall hear a word
'This is the way, walk in it.'"
that the way is explicit and clear
so much so that one points to it with a finger,
saying: "This is the way, walk in it."
And this is what is said:
"Who places a way in the sea."
"mighty" is gevuros, the aspect of fear —
"the mighty one who conquers his inclination."
that is, the holiness of Yaakov Avinu,
who is the Vav, the letter of truth,
and he is the middle bar
that runs through from end to end.
And this is "nesiv" plus the Hei:
upon the attribute of Malchus, the lower Hei.
That is, regarding one who did not merit
so as to attain "Who places a way in the sea" —
comes through the attribute of fear,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁמָּצִינוּ בְּאַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
as we find with Avraham Avinu, a"h,
that at the test of the Akeidah it is written (Bereishis 22:12):
And likewise the perfection of Torah
one may end up among those who "go to the left" with it;
הוּא רַק עַל יְדֵי דִבְרֵי תוֹרָה.
comes only through words of Torah.
And the holiness of Avraham Avinu
and Yitzchak Avinu, who were perfected:
Avraham became included in the attribute of fear,
"And it was, when Yitzchak was old" —
that he was perfected in his attribute
up to the attribute of Atika;
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר בְּאַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ (שָׁם כד, א)
just as it says of Avraham Avinu (ibid. 24:1):
"And Avraham was old, advanced in days,"
דְּאָמְרוּ בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (זֹהַר חֵלֶק א קכט, א)
of which they said in the holy Zohar (Zohar I 129a):
that is, the first three sefiros.
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (שָׁם קלג, ב)
And as is written in the holy Zohar (ibid. 133b):
and likewise fire became included in water."
But even one who is not
מִכָּל מָקוֹם עַל יְדֵי מַיִם עַזִּים
the holiness of Yaakov Avinu, a"h,
And this is why it says,
"saying: 'This is the way, walk in it'" —
which refers to one who merits
"Who places a way in the sea,"
and for him "this is the way" shines,
is like pointing to it with a finger,
"when you turn right and when you turn left";
for when one is not so clarified,
that is, "mighty waters," as mentioned above,
the aspect of Torah and fear —
there shines for him "nesiv" plus the Hei:
through the Vav, the middle bar,
the holiness of Yaakov Avinu, a"h,
from Kesser Elyon down to the lower Hei.
And this is the work of the month of Elul,
"Who places a way in the sea,"
which is the radiance of life,
shine upon the lower Yud, the attribute of Malchus.
And this is a preparation for Tishrei,
the time of fear and teshuvah,
"Malchiyos — so that you crown Me King over you."
And if they merit to rectify completely,
as "Who places a way in the sea" alludes,
then they will be redeemed in Tishrei
כְּשִׁיטַת רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר (רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה יא, א)
according to the view of Rabbi Eliezer (Rosh Hashanah 11a):
"In Tishrei they are destined to be redeemed,"
that they are redeemed through teshuvah;
